[LUNI.4.1.3] **Dimension representation.** A dimension is an integer
**exponent vector** over the axis set — the 7 baked axes plus any
declared independent axes ([LUNI.4.1.4]). `watt` is `(length=2,
mass=1, time=−3)`. A non-base `unit dimension` introduces either a
*derived* dimension (a span of existing axes) or a new *independent
axis*.
